body:
All Saints' Day, November 1st, is a public holiday in Croatia and the Zagreb Stock Exchange doesn't trade on it, but the `Croatia` calendar treats it as a business day. It is in the current ZSE list for 2027 (https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110: "Monday November 1st All Saint's Day") and in the lists of the previous years, e.g. 2024: https://web.archive.org/web/20241113132136/https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110.

The 2024 list also has Wednesday, April 17th, 2024, the day of the parliamentary election, which I added as a one-off.

With the change, the calendar matches the ZSE lists for 2021 to 2027:

- 2021 and 2022: https://web.archive.org/web/20220122214329/https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2023: https://web.archive.org/web/20230308112714/https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2024: https://web.archive.org/web/20241113132136/https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2025: https://web.archive.org/web/20250420010354/https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2026 and 2027: https://zse.hr/en/non-trading-days/110

`testCroatia` now compares the holiday list for 2024 to 2027; it fails on master (April 17th, 2024, November 1st, 2024 and November 1st, 2027 are missing) and passes with the change.
title: Add All Saints' Day to the Croatia calendar
